name: io.github.ilyautov/marketplaces-mcp-ru
title: Marketplaces MCP (RU) — Wildberries, Ozon, Yandex Market, Avito
description: Wildberries, Ozon, Yandex Market & Avito seller APIs in your AI assistant — schema-driven, safety-gated.

environmentVariables.name: WB_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Wildberries Seller API token (seller.wildberries.ru → Settings → API access). Leave unset if you do not sell on WB.

environmentVariables.name: OZON_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Ozon Seller Client ID (seller.ozon.ru → Settings → API keys).

environmentVariables.name: OZON_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Ozon Seller API key paired with the Client ID.

environmentVariables.name: OZON_PERF_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Ozon Performance (ads) API Client ID. Optional.

environmentVariables.name: OZON_PERF_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Ozon Performance API Client Secret. Optional.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_MARKET_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Yandex Market Partner API key (partner.market.yandex.ru → Settings → API access). Optional.

environmentVariables.name: AVITO_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Avito API client_id (avito.ru → Для бизнеса → Интеграции → API). Optional.

environmentVariables.name: AVITO_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Avito API client_secret paired with the client_id. Optional.
